overview: The Medford City Council convened its 2022 organizational meeting to elect officers, establish committee rules, and address administrative resolutions, personnel reclassifications, and municipal policy issues.

items.title: Election of Council President for 2022
items.summary: Elected Councilor Nicole Morell as Council President for 2022.

items.title: Election of Council Vice President for 2022
items.summary: Elected Councilor Zac Bears as Council Vice President for 2022.

items.title: Adoption of Council Standing Rules (Paper 22-003)
items.summary: Approved adopting the Council's standing rules for the 2022 legislative session.

items.title: Transfer of Pending Papers to 2022 Council (Paper 22-004)
items.summary: Approved transferring all pending papers and items in committee from the 2020-2021 Council to the 2022 session.

items.title: Council Meeting Schedule Amendment (Paper 22-010)
items.summary: Referred a proposal to transition regular Council meetings to a biweekly schedule to the Subcommittee on Rules.

items.title: Council Standing Committees Rule Update (Paper 22-011)
items.summary: Approved updating Council rules to authorize the President to establish subcommittees and appoint members after a motion to table failed.

items.title: Comprehensive Review of Council Rules (Paper 22-012)
items.summary: Referred a resolution to review and modernize all Council rules to the Subcommittee on Rules.

items.title: Review of Election Commission Model (Paper 22-013)
items.summary: Referred a resolution evaluating the creation of a municipal Election Commission under state law to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Paid Family and Medical Leave Option (Paper 22-014)
items.summary: Referred a proposal for the city to join the state's Paid Family and Medical Leave program for municipal employees to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Victualler License for GNP Pizza (Paper 21-021)
items.summary: Approved a victualler license petition for Michael LaChapelle operating GNP Pizza at 51 High Street.

items.title: Proposal to Change Council Meeting Night (Paper 22-005)
items.summary: Referred a resolution to change regular Council meeting nights from Tuesday to Wednesday to the Subcommittee on Rules.

items.title: Meeting Dedication to Michael J. Callahan (Paper 22-006)
items.summary: Approved dedicating the meeting to the memory of former Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callahan following a moment of silence.

items.title: Five-Year Gas Leak Mitigation Plan (Paper 22-007)
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting an administrative plan on gas leaks and inviting National Grid to a future meeting.

items.title: Vacant Positions and Organizational Structure Update (Paper 22-008)
items.summary: Approved requesting a report on funded vacant positions and an interim municipal organizational chart.

items.title: Public Works Vocational Training Opportunities (Paper 22-009)
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting school officials explore expanding public works vocational pathways and report back within 90 days.

items.title: Status Update on Remaining Cannabis Licenses (Paper 22-015)
items.summary: Approved requesting an administrative status update on awarding the city's three remaining retail cannabis licenses.

items.title: Opposition to Proposed Encore Casino Venue (Paper 22-016)
items.summary: Approved requesting the administration present its plan to oppose Encore Casino's proposed 1,800-seat performance venue.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions (Papers 22-017, 22-018, 22-020)
items.summary: Approved condolence resolutions for Lena Machette, Barbara Sloan, and Eugene Martini.

items.title: Distribution of COVID-19 At-Home Test Kits (Paper 22-019)
items.summary: Approved requesting the administration procure and distribute rapid COVID-19 home test kits to residents using ARPA funds.

items.title: FY22 Budget Amendment for Legal Services (Paper 22-022)
items.summary: Tabled for one week under Rule 20 a proposed budget amendment increasing contracted legal services funding to $81,600.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel Ordinance Amendments (Paper 22-023)
items.summary: Passed first reading amending non-union salary classifications for the Finance Director/Auditor and Human Resources Director.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Third and First Readings (Paper 21-631)
items.summary: Passed third reading for general non-union positions and first reading for ARPA-funded municipal positions.

items.title: Public Participation and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Ruled a non-resident public participation petition out of order and approved the December 21, 2021 meeting records.
